cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?

mechanism: A uses its pupil trained eye for composition and color to reroute repeated questions about a suspicious hand-holding person into card design and a gift.
confusable: Not neutral photography advice: each lesson diverts the same unanswered identity question into a safer aesthetic decision.
comparison: Dinner logistics as diversion versus visual-design praise as diversion.
